name: Anthony
summary: Raj Comics' undead avenger: a murdered musician who rises from his grave in storms to punish those who wrong the innocent, armed with cold fire and a crow named Prince.
origin: Anthony Gonsalves was a young musician whose popular album Crow Music (Crow Sangeet) made his rivals jealous. They killed him, leaving behind his wife Julia and daughter Maria. His pet crow, Prince, kept watch at the tombstone, and whenever an innocent person suffers injustice, Prince's cries gather a storm and Anthony climbs out of the grave to deliver justice. The character is openly inspired by James O'Barr's The Crow. Some sources spell his surname Gonsalvez.

firstAppearance.title: Kaanv Kaanv (Raj Comics General #651)
firstAppearance.issue: Date and issue as given by a single source, Comicsbyte

powers: Cannot be harmed by ordinary weapons
Cold fire (Thandi Aag), a hellfire weapon
His wounds heal once the wrongdoer is dealt with

storyline.title: A song and a grudge
storyline.beat: Rivals jealous of the musician Anthony Gonsalves kill him, leaving his wife Julia and daughter Maria behind.

storyline.title: The crow cries
storyline.beat: Prince the crow mourns at the tombstone, and when an innocent suffers, his cries bring a storm and Anthony rises from his grave.

storyline.title: Cold fire
storyline.beat: Anthony hunts wrongdoers across horror-tinged cases, finishing them with his cold fire, and his body mends only once the culprit has paid.

storyline.title: Itihaas and Venu
storyline.beat: A police inspector who later becomes DCP Itihaas, along with Venu (also called Saza), helps him in his cases.

storyline.title: Reborn as King
storyline.beat: In a later storyline Anthony is reborn as Maria's son King, living as King by day and becoming Anthony after dark.

gossip.text: Anthony is Raj Comics' answer to The Crow, and one source adds Ghost Rider to his influences.
His cold fire is also called hellfire; Comicsbyte says it does not burn but torments, and Indianetzone says it is believed to torture the soul.
Anthony is just an ordinary ghost haunting people.
gossip.truth: He is a returned avenger with superhuman strength and teleportation who can be called back by his crow, and he later joins the Brahmand Rakshak team.

gossip.text: When his soul leaves his body, the corpse lies still, and rivals have even possessed it, Count Dracula among them.
For a while water was his weakness; the limit was lifted after his second resurrection.

quiz.q: Which Western comic character, created by James O'Barr, inspired Raj Comics' Anthony?
quiz.why: Anthony and his plot are openly inspired by The Crow.

quiz.q: What is the name of Anthony's pet crow?
quiz.why: Prince the crow mourns at his tombstone and calls him back.

quiz.q: What is the name of Anthony's signature fire?
quiz.why: His weapon is a cold fire, also called hellfire.

quiz.q: In a later storyline, who is Anthony reborn as?
quiz.why: He returns as Maria's son King, living as King by day.

theme.tagline: A crow calls, a storm answers, the grave opens.

timeline.title: Kaanv Kaanv
timeline.note: Comicsbyte names Kaanv Kaanv, General #651, as his first issue, a horror-toned Raj Comics mini-series.

timeline.title: Chitaawar, issue 41
timeline.note: A 32-page Rs 8 issue pits Anthony against Gorilla and the tantric Bhairavnath, with a sequel in Ye Hai Maut Anthony Ki.

timeline.title: A busy year in the catalogue
timeline.note: The Michigan State University library lists nine Anthony issues for 2003, out of 27 from 1997 to 2005.

timeline.title: Collector's edition
timeline.note: In September 2025 Raj Comics by Manoj Gupta announces a 192-page Anthony collector's edition with a poster and bookmark.

facts.text: His pet crow Prince sits on his tombstone, and Prince's cries in the graveyard summon storms that bring Anthony out of the grave.
His signature weapon is cold fire, also called hellfire, a lethal flame that does what ordinary fire cannot.
After his first death he became afraid of water; the article says that limit disappeared after his second resurrection.
He regenerates only after his enemy has been dealt with, so his wounds heal only once justice is done.
While his spirit is away, his body lies completely still, and enemies including Count Dracula have taken it over for a while.
He can command spirits, souls and demons as well as crows and ravens, and can swap bodies with other people.
In one issue he is said to put his own head back in place after losing it, a trick that makes him very hard to stop.
In a later storyline he is reborn as Maria's son King, living as King by day and turning into Anthony after dark. His base is Roopnagar.
Wikipedia gives his aliases as The Dead and Zinda Murda, which means a living corpse.
Comicsbyte says he is active only at night and signs his work with a crow-shaped mark.
Anthony has teamed up with Doga (in Mard aur Murda and Thandi Aag), Nagraj (Nagraj aur Dracula), Shakti and Parmanu, according to Comicsbyte.

In folklore as Comicsbyte tells it, only a crow can spot Chitaawar wood, which cuts through iron doors and which crows use to free chicks that have been tied up. Issue 41 (1999) turns that into Anthony's story.
Anthony was a musician whose album Crow Music, also called Crow Sangeet, became a big hit, and the jealousy of his rivals is what got him killed.
Comicsbyte jokes that his line is a warning: do not play Crow Music, or Anthony will turn up.
He can teleport as far as his eyes can see, says Comicsbyte, which also gives his height as 6 feet and his weight as 75 kg.
His first four comics were Kaanv Kaanv, Prince Crow, Crow Sangeet and Anthony, after which readers took to him and he became an established Raj Comics hero known as the angel of the night.
Comicsbyte says Anthony wakes at night yet never meets his wife Julie, though he sometimes sees his daughter Maria for a few moments, and a father's pain shows in his words.
Comicsbyte opens its Anthony profile by noting that his name matches the famous My Name Is Anthony Gonsalves song sung on screen by Amitabh Bachchan in Amar Akbar Anthony.
Raj Comics' series list names the Anthony line the Crow Series, a name that fits his crow companion and his Crow Music origin.
Psychic powers like telepathy cannot touch him, and he can teleport anywhere he wishes, says Wikipedia.
Indianetzone says he is strong enough to throw heavy vehicles aside, and that weapons cannot hurt him.

kidSummary: Anthony is a Raj Comics hero who was once a musician. When an innocent person is wronged, his crow Prince calls up a storm and Anthony returns from his grave to put things right with his cold fire.
